title: Glessner's north windows: slimmer columns between the paired lights
items: On the 18th Street side of Glessner House, the stone column between each pair of upstairs windows is now as slim as the 1965 survey photographs show it: about 1.3 feet at the capital rather than 1.9, with a taller carved capital and a low base block.
Read from both north photographs, which agree to within an inch on the clear pair; the windows either side widen to suit.
